name: Naver Shopping: daily rank & price changes to Google Sheets

nodes.name: Apify: Naver Shopping search
nodes.notes: Calls the Apify API (run-sync-get-dataset-items). Needs a Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>. Change maxTotalChargeUsd to cap spend per run.

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Create a sheet with a header row matching these columns: date, keyword, rank, previousRank, rankChange, price, previousPrice, priceChange, isNewInTop, title, mallName, productId, url

parameters.content: Setup: 1) Create Header Auth credential (Authorization = Bearer <Apify token>) and select it on the Apify node. 2) Select your Google Sheets credential, paste the Sheet ID, create header row (see node notes). 3) Edit keywords in the Apify node. Keep options identical between runs; rank/price history is kept per keyword in the Apify key-value store 'n8n-naver-rank-watch'.
